`final class NodeMouseScrollEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeInputEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeMouseScrollEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeMouseScrollEvent.java)

The event of `handleMouseScroll` on a node, with the position of the pointer and the turn of the wheel.

## Description

A node that scrolls its content consumes the wheel while it can still scroll in that direction.

## Learn more

- [Layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/layout/#scroll-a-node)

## Creation details

<a id="NodeMouseScrollEvent-factory-create"></a>

### create

`<N extends Node> NodeMouseScrollEvent<N> create(N node, double mouseX, double mouseY, double notchesX, double notchesY, IConsumableEvent source)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the event for a node, the position of the pointer and the notches on each axis.
`source` is the input that the event belongs to, or `null` for an input of its own.

## Method details

<a id="NodeMouseScrollEvent-method-getMouseX"></a>

### getMouseX

`double getMouseX()` 

Returns the horizontal position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI.

<a id="NodeMouseScrollEvent-method-getMouseY"></a>

### getMouseY

`double getMouseY()` 

Returns the vertical position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI.

<a id="NodeMouseScrollEvent-method-getNotchesX"></a>

### getNotchesX

`double getNotchesX()` 

Returns the horizontal turn of the wheel or of the touchpad, in notches, fractions included.

<a id="NodeMouseScrollEvent-method-getNotchesY"></a>

### getNotchesY

`double getNotchesY()` 

Returns the vertical turn of the wheel, in notches, fractions included: positive when the wheel turns up, negative when it turns down.
A scrolling node moves its content by 30 design pixels per notch, times its `scrollSpeed`.
